test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61efc87d478ec6de829fb941f225f57e1037f90a74d1a44b9465cb1aa1e34839.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**The shaded circle rotates 2 place in clockwise direction, and in next box it rotated 3 place in anticlockwise direction, continued this pattern till last box.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92269597b7d3dedfff0398432b1fcefc209db5f0c7994435f7eea6e2c90f73cc.png] 

So, Option 2 will complete the series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
